ALTER TABLE `agents` 
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `companyId` int AFTER `userId`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `departmentId` int AFTER `companyId`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `parentAgentId` int AFTER `departmentId`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `roleTitle` varchar(128) AFTER `description`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `jobDescription` text AFTER `roleTitle`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `tools` json AFTER `capabilities`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `connectorType` enum('internal','openai','anthropic','gemini','custom_api','crewai') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'internal' AFTER `tools`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `connectorConfig` json AFTER `connectorType`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `heartbeatCron` varchar(64) AFTER `connectorConfig`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `heartbeatEnabled` boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false AFTER `heartbeatCron`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `lastHeartbeat` timestamp AFTER `heartbeatEnabled`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `nextHeartbeat` timestamp AFTER `lastHeartbeat`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `monthlyBudget` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT '0' AFTER `nextHeartbeat`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `budgetUsed` decimal(10,2) DEFAULT '0' AFTER `monthlyBudget`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `budgetAlertThreshold` decimal(5,2) DEFAULT '75' AFTER `budgetUsed`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `failoverAgentId` int AFTER `budgetAlertThreshold`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `totalCostIncurred` decimal(12,2) DEFAULT '0' AFTER `totalValueCreated`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `orgChartX` int DEFAULT 0 AFTER `isMarketplaceListing`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `orgChartY` int DEFAULT 0 AFTER `orgChartX`;

ALTER TABLE `agents` MODIFY COLUMN `type` enum('ceo','cto','cmo','cfo','vp','manager','specialist','marketing','research','sales','admin','custom') NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE `agents` MODIFY COLUMN `status` enum('idle','active','paused','error','terminated') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'idle';

ALTER TABLE `okrs`
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `companyId` int AFTER `userId`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `agentId` int AFTER `companyId`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `parentOkrId` int AFTER `agentId`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `level` enum('company','department','agent','task') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'company' AFTER `parentOkrId`;

ALTER TABLE `tasks`
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `companyId` int AFTER `userId`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `parentTaskId` int AFTER `agentId`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `okrId` int AFTER `parentTaskId`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `tokenCost` decimal(10,4) DEFAULT '0' AFTER `actualHours`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `apiCallCost` decimal(10,4) DEFAULT '0' AFTER `tokenCost`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `totalCost` decimal(10,4) DEFAULT '0' AFTER `apiCallCost`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `delegatedFromAgentId` int AFTER `executionLog`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `delegatedToAgentId` int AFTER `delegatedFromAgentId`;

ALTER TABLE `tasks` MODIFY COLUMN `status` enum('pending','in_progress','completed','failed','awaiting_human','delegated') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending';

ALTER TABLE `poo_receipts`
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `companyId` int AFTER `userId`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `costIncurred` decimal(10,4) DEFAULT '0' AFTER `dollarValueCreated`;

ALTER TABLE `inbox_items`
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `companyId` int AFTER `userId`;

ALTER TABLE `inbox_items` MODIFY COLUMN `type` enum('decision_required','budget_approval','task_review','alert','poo_generated','hire_approval','strategy_review','kill_switch') NOT NULL;

ALTER TABLE `marketplace_listings`
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `blueprintId` int AFTER `agentId`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `listingType` enum('agent','blueprint','skill') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'agent' AFTER `blueprintId`;

ALTER TABLE `marketplace_listings` MODIFY COLUMN `pricingModel` enum('monthly','annual','usage','value_capture','one_time','revenue_share','franchise') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'monthly';

ALTER TABLE `marketplace_listings` MODIFY COLUMN `agentId` int NULL;

ALTER TABLE `creator_partnerships`
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `endorsedBlueprintId` int AFTER `endorsedListingId`;

ALTER TABLE `decision_log`
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `companyId` int AFTER `userId`,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS `optionsConsidered` json AFTER `outcome`;
